caption: A cyclist riding along a flat street stops pedalling and rests both feet on the pedals, and the bicycle coasts on down the street, gradually slowing.
expectation: The bicycle keeps rolling forward after the legs stop, with no pause or jolt at the moment pedalling ends; the path stays straight and the wheels keep turning; it slows only gently, never speeding up, stopping dead, or rolling backward while the feet stay still.

caption: A girl spinning on an office chair grabs the edge of the desk to stop, and her ponytail swings on around her head after the chair has stopped.
expectation: The hair continues in the direction of the spin for a moment after the chair halts and then falls; it does not stop with the chair or swing the other way first.

caption: A stack of newspapers rides a conveyor belt in a printing plant, and when the belt is stopped the stack slides on a little before halting.
expectation: The slide is in the belt's former direction and starts as the belt stops; the stack stops within a short distance and does not slide backward.

caption: The cord holding a hanging flowerpot on a porch snaps, and the pot falls and breaks on the boards below.
expectation: The pot drops straight down the moment the cord parts, speeding up, and breaks on impact with soil spilling; it does not hover or fall sideways.

caption: A sandbag hanging from a hook in a gym is unhooked and drops onto the mat below.
expectation: The bag starts falling the instant it leaves the hook, drops straight down with increasing speed, lands on the mat and slumps; the empty hook swings; the bag does not drift sideways or pause.

caption: A phone balanced on a balcony rail slips off and falls into the swimming pool below with a splash.
expectation: The phone falls straight down, faster as it goes, and enters the water with a splash then sinks; it does not drift outward or float.

caption: A pigeon flies straight at a closed window, hits the glass with a thump, bounces off and drops to the ground below.
expectation: The pigeon stops at the pane and is thrown back at the instant of impact; the glass stays whole and nothing passes through it; the bird falls after the bounce and does not fly on through the window.

caption: A football kicked at goal hits the crossbar and drops down onto the goal line.
expectation: The ball rebounds off the bar at the moment of contact and falls under gravity; the bar does not bend and the ball does not pass through it.

caption: A cue ball is struck into a tight triangle of balls on a pool table, and the balls scatter across the table in all directions.
expectation: The balls move only after being struck, spread outward from the impact, and none overlaps another; the cue ball slows sharply.

caption: A marble rolls across a table and hits a heavy steel ball at rest; the marble bounces back the way it came while the steel ball barely moves.
expectation: At contact the marble reverses and rolls back slower than it arrived; the steel ball shifts at most slightly; neither passes through the other and the steel ball does not shoot off.

caption: A bottle cap spun on a kitchen counter spins in place, slows, and rattles to a stop.
expectation: The spin slows steadily and the cap wobbles more as it slows; it does not speed up or stop instantly.

caption: A wet bar of soap is squeezed in a hand in the bath, slips out of the grip and skids across the bottom of the tub.
expectation: The soap leaves the hand as the fingers close and shoots out in one direction; it skids across the wet surface in a straight line and slows to a stop or stops against the side of the tub; it does not hover, change direction on its own, or stay stuck to the hand.

caption: A tin can lying on its side and a wooden block are given the same shove across a floor; the can rolls far while the block stops within a short distance.
expectation: Both start moving together; the block slows quickly and stops while the can rolls on much farther before stopping; neither speeds up or changes direction on its own.

caption: A water balloon is lobbed over a garden fence and arcs over into a paddling pool on the other side.
expectation: The balloon rises, clears the fence near the top of its arc, wobbles in flight, and falls into the pool with a splash; it does not travel flat or hang above the fence.

caption: A weighted fishing line is cast far out over a lake from the bank, and the weight splashes into the water.
expectation: The weight flies in an arc, pulling line behind it, and drops into the water; it does not stop in the air or fly straight.

caption: A tennis ball rolls off the end of a table and curves down to the floor, landing a short distance out from the table's edge, and bounces on.
expectation: The ball keeps moving forward as it leaves the edge and drops in a curve that steepens; it lands beyond the edge, not straight below it, and does not stop in the air or fall straight down.

caption: A house of playing cards stands on a table; the table is bumped and the house collapses into a heap.
expectation: The collapse begins at the bump and runs through the structure in under a second; every card ends flat or leaning on the table; none stays balanced in the air.

caption: A ladder leaning at too shallow an angle against a garden wall slides out at its feet and falls flat to the ground.
expectation: The feet slip away from the wall first, the top slides down the wall as the angle flattens, and the ladder lands flat; it does not stay propped once the feet move or fall toward the wall.

caption: A bin standing in a yard is knocked by the swinging end of a long ladder and tips over.
expectation: The bin tips at the moment the ladder end hits it and falls in the direction of the swing, spilling; it does not move before contact.

caption: The cord of a window blind is pulled, and the blind gathers upward as the cord runs down.
expectation: The blind rises only as fast as the cord is pulled and stops when the pulling stops; the cord stays taut on the pulled side and does not stretch.

caption: A marionette is lifted off the stage by its control bar, and the strings go taut and the puppet's limbs hang from them.
expectation: The strings straighten as the bar lifts, the limbs rise only when their strings tighten, and the strings go slack when the puppet is set down.

caption: The anchor rope of a small boat is hauled in, and the rope comes up taut and dripping until the anchor breaks the surface.
expectation: The rope runs straight down into the water under load and stays taut while pulled; water drips from it; the anchor appears only when enough rope is in.

caption: A vacuum-packed foam mattress is cut open, and the flat compressed slab swells and puffs up toward its full thickness.
expectation: The foam expands as soon as the bag is opened, thickening evenly and slowing as it nears full size; it does not stay flat, shrink, or grow beyond a mattress shape.

caption: A rubber duck is squeezed under the bathwater and released, and it squirts water and puffs back to shape.
expectation: The duck flattens while squeezed, a jet of water comes out of its hole, and it refills and rounds out when released.

caption: A sheet of aluminium foil is pressed down over an upturned bowl and lifted off, and the foil keeps the bowl's rounded shape.
expectation: The foil wrinkles and moulds to the bowl while pressed and holds that dome shape after it is lifted away; it does not spring back flat or tear.

caption: A cable tie holding a bundle of cables is snipped with cutters, and the bundle springs apart into loose cables.
expectation: The tie parts where the blades close and the cables spread out at that instant; the tie does not rejoin and the bundle does not stay tight without it.

caption: A plank on a sawhorse is sawn through, and the cut end drops to the ground as the saw comes through.
expectation: The kerf deepens with each stroke, sawdust falls, and the piece parts only when the saw is through; the two pieces do not rejoin.

caption: A sheet of paper is fed into a shredder, and it comes out the bottom as a bundle of thin strips.
expectation: The sheet is drawn in at the top and strips emerge below as it passes; the sheet does not reappear whole.

caption: Thick paint is poured from a tin onto a flat canvas, and it spreads slowly into a rounded pool and stops.
expectation: The paint flows outward from where it lands, slower and thicker than water would, and settles into a rounded shape with a raised edge; it does not keep spreading thin or climb back into the tin.

caption: A large stone is dropped into a bucket full of water, and water spills over the rim onto the ground.
expectation: The splash and overflow happen as the stone enters, the level stays at the rim afterward, and the stone sinks to the bottom; the stone does not pass through the bucket.

caption: The plug of a full bathtub is pulled, and as the water drains a swirling whirlpool forms over the drain.
expectation: The level falls steadily and a dimple over the drain deepens into a spinning funnel that grows as the water gets shallower; the water does not rise or spin without draining.

caption: A bucket with a hole near its bottom is filled from a tap, and a thin stream squirts out of the hole and arcs onto the ground.
expectation: The stream comes only from the hole, arcs outward and down, and gets weaker as the level in the bucket falls; it does not squirt upward.

caption: A tray of dry rice is tilted to one side, and the rice slides to the low edge and piles up there while the high side clears.
expectation: The grains flow downhill as a sheet once the tilt is steep enough, collect against the low rim, and the pile's surface settles at a slope; they do not move uphill or stay spread evenly on a tilted tray.

caption: A sandbag on a low wall is punctured near its bottom, and a thin stream of sand runs out onto the ground while the bag slowly slumps.
expectation: The stream comes only from the hole and falls straight down, building a small cone below; the bag sags and wrinkles as it empties; the sand does not flow back in or stop while the bag is still full.

caption: A sack of potatoes is tipped out onto a barn floor, and the potatoes tumble out and roll apart into a loose spread.
expectation: The potatoes fall and roll away from the pile, coming to rest scattered; they do not stack or stay in the sack's shape.

caption: A model rocket reaches the top of its flight, its nose pops off and a parachute unfolds, and the rocket drifts slowly down under the canopy.
expectation: The canopy fills and rounds out above the rocket, whose fall slows sharply the moment it opens; the rocket hangs below the canopy and drifts with the wind; it does not keep falling fast or rise.

caption: The sail of a small boat is let loose in a breeze, and it fills and bellies out to one side.
expectation: The sail bulges away from the wind and flaps when the wind drops; it does not belly toward the wind.

caption: A gust of wind reaches a row of wind turbines on a hill, and the blades start turning and speed up.
expectation: The blades begin turning only when the wind arrives and slow when it drops; all turbines turn the same way.

caption: A gymnast performs a cartwheel across a mat, hands then feet touching the ground in turn.
expectation: Her hands and feet touch the mat one after another in sequence, her body stays whole and bends only at the joints, and she lands upright.

caption: A person walking along a pavement catches a foot on a raised kerb, stumbles forward with arms flung out, and recovers balance after two quick steps.
expectation: The stumble begins at the trip, the body pitches forward and the arms come up; the recovery steps are quick and in the direction of travel; the person does not fall backward or freeze mid-fall.

caption: A person carries a full bucket of water in one hand and leans the body to the other side to balance the load.
expectation: The lean is away from the bucket and appears as soon as the bucket is lifted; the free arm may swing out; the person does not lean toward the bucket or walk upright as if it weighed nothing.

caption: A person standing on one leg wobbles, sways further, and puts the other foot down to stay upright.
expectation: The sway grows before the foot comes down and stops after it lands; the foot lands on the side the body was leaning toward; the person does not stay perfectly still or fall over.

caption: A silk scarf draped over the back of a chair slides off and pools in soft folds on the floor.
expectation: The scarf slips down following the chair's shape, falls as a limp sheet, and lands in loose folds; it does not stay rigid, float, or land flat as a square.

caption: A sock is pulled over a foot, the opening stretching as the fabric is drawn up over the heel and ankle.
expectation: The sock stretches around the foot and follows its shape; the foot goes into the opening, not through the fabric.

caption: A wet paper towel is laid over the top of an upright bottle, and it drapes and clings to the bottle's shape.
expectation: The towel folds down over the bottle's shoulders and hangs along its sides, showing the shape beneath; it does not stay flat like a lid or slide off.

caption: A coil of rope is thrown onto a dock, and it lands in a loose tangle of loops.
expectation: The rope bends into loops that lie on top of one another; it does not pass through itself or land in a straight line.

caption: A coin is pushed under the edge of a rug, and when the rug is lifted the coin lies where it was pushed.
expectation: A small bump shows in the rug where the coin is; the coin is hidden while covered and is the same coin, in that spot, when the rug is lifted.

caption: A bus drives behind a tall building and emerges from the other side a moment later.
expectation: The bus is hidden for a time matching its speed and the building's width, and reappears at the same speed and heading; it does not show through the building.

caption: A marble is dropped into the top of a long cardboard tube standing upright, and it comes out of the bottom and rolls away.
expectation: The marble is hidden inside the tube and exits at the bottom after a short delay; the same marble comes out, and nothing exits before it enters.

caption: A cat crawls under a blanket on a bed, and a moving lump travels across the blanket to the far edge, where the cat comes out.
expectation: The lump is the cat's size and moves continuously; the cat is not visible through the blanket and emerges only at the edge.

caption: A train pulls out of a station, and a suitcase standing loose in the aisle tips over toward the rear of the carriage.
expectation: The suitcase begins to tip as the train starts moving, falls toward the back of the carriage, and lies still once down; it does not tip before the train moves or fall toward the front.

caption: A tablecloth is pulled sharply out from under a set of plates and glasses, and the dishes stay almost where they were on the bare table.
expectation: The cloth leaves the table in one quick motion while the dishes shift only slightly and settle; they do not fly off with the cloth, rise, or move before the cloth is pulled.

caption: A ripe apple comes loose from a branch and drops through the leaves to the grass beneath the tree.
expectation: The apple falls straight down, speeding up as it goes, brushes through leaves without stopping, and comes to rest on the grass below the branch; it does not drift sideways, pause, or rise.

caption: A drone hovering over a field loses power, and it drops straight down into the grass.
expectation: The drone starts falling the moment its rotors stop, accelerates downward, and lands below where it hovered; it does not glide away, slow before landing, or stay in the air with the rotors still.

caption: A wrecking ball swings into a brick wall, and bricks burst out of the far side as the ball is stopped and swings back.
expectation: The bricks move only at the moment of impact and fly away from the ball; the ball loses most of its speed at the wall and swings back less far than it came; the ball does not pass through the wall or stop before touching it.

caption: A car brakes hard on a dry road, its tyres screech and leave dark skid marks, and it stops within a short distance.
expectation: The marks appear behind the tyres only while the car is braking and stay on the road after it stops; the car slows quickly and comes to rest, not sliding on as it would on ice.

caption: A wooden crate rests on a board that is slowly tilted up at one end; the crate stays put as the slope grows, then suddenly slides down to the bottom.
expectation: The crate does not move at shallow angles, starts sliding all at once when the slope is steep, and speeds up on the way down; it does not creep at every angle or slide uphill.

caption: A pumpkin is launched from a catapult on a field, arcs high over the grass, and smashes on the ground far away.
expectation: The pumpkin rises, slows near the top of its arc, and falls faster toward the ground; it breaks apart only when it lands and does not hover, change direction in the air, or bounce whole.

caption: A ping-pong ball is served, arcs over the net, bounces once on the far side of the table, and drops off the end.
expectation: The ball follows a smooth arc, bounces lower than its flight height, and falls off the table edge under gravity; it does not pass through the net, hover, or bounce higher than it came.

caption: A broom is stood upright on the end of its handle in the middle of a kitchen floor and let go; it stays for a moment, leans more and more, and falls to the floor.
expectation: The lean grows steadily faster once it starts and the broom falls in the direction it leaned; it does not stand indefinitely, right itself, or fall before it begins to lean.

caption: A round-bottomed roly-poly toy on a table is pushed over onto its side and let go, and it rocks back upright and settles.
expectation: The toy swings back toward upright as soon as it is released, rocks a few times with shrinking swings, and ends up standing; it does not stay on its side or tip over the other way.

caption: A backpack is hooked to a bungee cord hanging from a beam and let go; the cord stretches, the pack bounces back up, and it bobs up and down before settling.
expectation: The cord lengthens as the pack drops and shortens as it rises, each bounce smaller than the last; the pack never rises above the point where it was released and the cord does not go slack while the pack hangs.

caption: A wet blanket is thrown over a thin washing line, the line sags deeply, then snaps, and the blanket falls to the grass.
expectation: The sag deepens under the weight before the break; at the snap the two ends of the line spring apart and the blanket drops straight down; the line does not hold the load after breaking or rejoin.

caption: A brick is set on top of a coil spring standing on a table, the spring compresses under it, and when the brick is lifted off the spring extends again.
expectation: The spring shortens only while the brick is on it and returns to its full height after the brick is removed; it does not stay compressed or stretch longer than it started.

caption: A car reverses slowly into a lamp post, and its rear bumper dents inward and stays dented after it pulls forward.
expectation: The dent forms at the point of contact at the moment of impact and remains when the car moves away; the bumper does not spring back to shape and the post does not bend.

caption: A lawnmower runs across an overgrown lawn, and the grass behind it is cut short with clippings scattered.
expectation: The grass is shorter only where the mower has passed, the cut edge follows the mower's path, and clippings appear behind it; the grass ahead stays tall and does not grow back behind.

caption: A dog bites into a stuffed cushion on a sofa and tears it open, and white stuffing spills out through the rip.
expectation: The fabric parts where the teeth pull, the rip widens as the dog tugs, and stuffing comes out only through the rip; the cushion does not seal itself or shrink back to shape.

caption: An empty glass bottle is pushed neck-first under the water in a sink, and water flows in while a stream of bubbles escapes from the neck.
expectation: Water rises inside the bottle while air leaves as bubbles that climb to the surface; the bottle fills only as fast as the air escapes and does not fill instantly or stay empty under water.

caption: A snow plough drives down a street, and the snow rolls up along its blade and is left in a ridge at the roadside.
expectation: Snow piles against the blade and spills off its end as the plough moves, leaving a continuous ridge behind and a cleared strip in its path; snow does not pass through the blade or return to the cleared strip.

caption: The base of a steep pile of dry sand in a sandbox is scraped away, and a section of the slope above slides down as a sheet and comes to rest at a gentler angle.
expectation: The slide starts where the support was removed and moves downhill, grains flowing rather than tumbling as a block; the pile ends flatter than it began and does not steepen or rebuild itself.

caption: A car speeds past a pile of dry leaves at the roadside, and the leaves are whirled up in its wake and settle again behind it.
expectation: The leaves lift only as the car passes, swirl in the direction of travel, and drift back down after it has gone; they do not move before the car arrives or rise indefinitely.

caption: A gust through an open window blows the bedroom door shut with a bang.
expectation: The door swings closed in the direction the curtains blow and stops at the frame; it does not close in still air or swing against the wind.

caption: A person jumps down from a low garden wall, lands on both feet and bends deeply at the knees, then straightens up and walks on.
expectation: The knees bend on landing and the body sinks before rising again; the landing is heavier than the take-off; the person does not land stiff-legged, float down, or bounce back up onto the wall.

caption: A curtain is drawn along its rail to one side, and the fabric gathers into deep folds as it bunches at the end.
expectation: The folds grow deeper and closer together as more curtain arrives, the hem stays hanging under gravity, and the cloth does not stiffen, stretch, or pass through itself.

caption: A red sock is tossed into a front-loading washing machine with other clothes and the door shut; through the glass window the sock is seen tumbling past among the clothes.
expectation: The sock appears at the window now and then as the drum turns, always the same sock, and never outside the machine while the door is shut; it does not vanish for good or multiply.
